title: sign() hardcodes SHA-256 digest; DigestAlgorithm param ignored
description: sign() ignores the DigestAlgorithm variants Sha384 and Sha512 entirely — it always uses SHA-256 (set at line 40: 'let digest_alg = DigestAlgorithm::Sha256'). The SigningKey trait's sign() method receives a DigestAlgorithm, so implementors may reasonably expect to be called with the algorithm they advertised or prefer. A contributor who adds a signing key that only supports SHA-384 will be silently called with SHA-256. There is no mechanism in the trait for the key to advertise which digest it supports. The public API does not document that SHA-256 is the only option.
